verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a REST API, type-safe SDKs, an MCP server, skill files, and a Claude Code plugin. None of these is a first-party Vanta command-line tool; the 'install with one command' line refers to installing skill files, not to a Vanta CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
